inline.titleEn: 5 Steps to Read a Birth Chart Symbolically
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for reading Malia Obama's birth chart as a symbolic portrait of tendencies rather than a prediction

items.subEn: A July 4 birthday gives a Cancer Sun — look for privacy, loyalty, and care in how she is publicly described

items.nameEn: Flag what needs a birth time
items.subEn: Treat the Moon and Ascendant as pending until a verified time exists — say so rather than guessing
Notice where the Cancer theme lines up with her reserved presence — and where it doesn't, since people are always more than one placement

items.nameEn: Read aspects as themes, not verdicts
items.subEn: A tight aspect suggests recurring tension or ease — phrase as 'may surface as,' never 'this means she will'
End each observation reminding yourself you are reading archetype, not biography

inline.altEn: Two-column comparison of three common misreadings of Malia Obama's birth chart against their accurate corrected interpretations

linesEn: Quoting a full 'big three' as fact without a confirmed birth time
Saying 'her Cancer Sun means she will choose a private life'
Explaining her entire public image through Cancer alone

A placement describes a tendency, not a destiny, and can express in many directions
A chart is a web of placements — any single sign is only a starting note
